name: Jun Renaud
source:
Species: Human

It's you! You play as Jun (or whatever you name 'em!). You're a human who feels that you no longer fit in amongst humans, so you run away from home to live in an all-duenkhy community with your duenkhy friend, Lady. Your aspirations are to eventually make a living for yourself. You wear a mask to hide the fact that you're human.

[From [url=http://www.duenkhy.com/]official site[/url]]
